topics.label: Lecture introduction and framing
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic opens the lecture by framing the topic of complement and acknowledging its complexity.

topics.label: Overview and nomenclature of the complement system
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics establish the foundational concepts of the complement cascade and clarify its historical nomenclature.

topics.label: Complement activation pathways and C3 convertase generation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the central role of C3 and the three recognition pathways that converge to trigger its activation.

topics.label: Effector mechanisms of complement
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the primary downstream effector mechanisms by which activated complement eliminates pathogens.

topics.label: Regulation of complement and host cell protection
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the regulatory mechanisms and proteins that protect host cells from complement-mediated damage.

topics.label: Clinical consequences of complement deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the diverse clinical presentations and disease outcomes caused by deficiencies in specific complement components.

topics.label: Pathogen evasion of the complement system
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic examines the strategies employed by pathogens to evade complement defenses, using Staphylococcus aureus as a primary model.

topics.label: Lecture wrap-up and conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and provides a preview of the next topic on the adaptive immune system.
